findings.summary: ObserverRun success case passes only if the stub child is reaped before the first observer poll; the fake clock then jumps 970 to 1020 past term_at=1000 and latches external_work_deadline (observe.py:279).
findings.trigger: Child start-up plus ps exceed the first loop iteration, e.g. under load while the training operator runs.
findings.fix: Smaller clock steps near term_at, or wait for child exit before the first observer poll in the test.

findings.summary: All ObserverRun cases inject clock, so use_timer is False and the real ITIMER_REAL/SIGALRM arm, post-loop re-arm to hard_at, failure re-arm and restore are not exercised. Read-verified alignment only.
findings.trigger: A defect in the real timer path (e.g. success-path postflight cut at work) on the first real run.
findings.consequence: Successful run marked failed after the full work period, requiring incident handling.
findings.fix: Add Darwin real-timer timeout case with work=2 s (expect elapsed <= work+10) and a real-timer success case; test-only, observe.py byte-identical.

findings.summary: Calibration acceptance checked by hash only; it need not restate work 17141, postflight 120 or total 17271.
findings.trigger: Parent records an acceptance with different or unlabelled wall values.
findings.consequence: Registered wall budget not reviewed as intended (carried r1 finding 9, now with postflight).
findings.fix: Require the acceptance to carry work, postflight and total values and compare them with the draft before copying.

findings.summary: No mutation-style tests exist; behavioural tests do fail if the per-episode check or the postflight term is removed.
120 s postflight allowance rests on one prior sample (9.40 s gap, 15.5M frames), scaled linearly to 78.4 s; 1.53x margin.
findings.trigger: Postflight cost above linear scaling at full journal size.
findings.fix: Accept as worst-case bound with the calibration record.

findings.summary: Timeout path can reach work+130 total because failure accounting in finally runs up to hard_at; the worker never receives this time.
